Definition: from G4413 and G2476; one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion):--ringleader.
BiblicalUsage: Protostates means a ringleader, one who stands first in the ranks. It appears once, in the charge against Paul: we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the world's accusation was the church's compliment: they called Paul a ringleader because he led men to Christ, and he never denied it.
